missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated to characters
missing_methods.query: Assert tell your experience text is truncated to characters
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should verify that the text entered in the 'tell your experience' feedback field is truncated to a maximum character limit. Steps: 1) Retrieve the current text from the feedback edit field using get_entered_text() or similar method. 2) Get the character count display text using get_feedback_text_char_count() to verify the UI shows the correct count. 3) Assert that the length of the entered text does not exceed the expected_max_length parameter. 4) Return True if the text is properly truncated, False otherwise. 5) Should handle edge cases where text might be exactly at the limit or below it. The method should validate both the actual text length and the character counter display to ensure consistency.
missing_methods.rationale: While feedback.py has methods to input text (input_tell_your_experience) and get character count (get_feedback_text_char_count), there is no explicit method to assert that text is truncated to a specific character limit. This validation logic belongs in feedback.py as it directly relates to the feedback form's text input constraints.
